deletion_policy.description:
Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance. Defaults to "DELETE".
When a 'terraform destroy' or 'terraform apply' would delete the instance,
the command will fail if this field is set to "PREVENT" in Terraform state.
When set to "ABANDON", the command will remove the resource from Terraform
management without updating or deleting the resource in the API.
When set to "DELETE", deleting the resource is allowed.

description.description: The description specified for the model when it was created.

labels.description:
One or more labels that you can add, to organize your models.

**Note**: This field is non-authoritative, and will only manage the labels present in your configuration.
Please refer to the field 'effective_labels' for all of the labels present on the resource.

name.description: The name specified for the model.

online_prediction_console_logging.description: If true, online prediction nodes send stderr and stdout streams to Stackdriver Logging

online_prediction_logging.description: If true, online prediction access logs are sent to StackDriver Logging.

project.description: The ID of the project in which the resource belongs. If it is not provided, the provider project is used.

regions.description:
The list of regions where the model is going to be deployed.
Currently only one region per model is supported

default_version.description:
The default version of the model. This version will be used to handle
prediction requests that do not specify a version.

default_version.name.description: The name specified for the version when it was created.
